name: Nobu Hotel Marbella

address.street: Boulevard Principe Alfonso von Hohenlohe s/n

insider_take: Where Japanese minimalism meets Andalusian glamour on the legendary Golden Mile
whats_special: This is the first Nobu hotel in Spain, featuring the brand's signature zen aesthetics with Mediterranean influences. The hotel sits on Marbella's prestigious Golden Mile, just steps from the beach and minutes from Puerto Banús marina. Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's renowned restaurant anchors the property, offering his world-famous Japanese-Peruvian fusion cuisine with locally-sourced Andalusian ingredients.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop terrace for panoramic views of the Mediterranean while enjoying Nobu's signature black cod miso - the combination of flavors and scenery is absolutely unforgettable.
dont_miss: The hotel's Zen garden courtyard perfect for morning meditation, the exclusive beach club with Balinese-style cabanas, and easy access to Marbella's historic Old Town with its charming orange tree-lined streets and whitewashed buildings just 10 minutes away.
pros: World-renowned Nobu restaurant and Japanese cuisine on-site
Prime beachfront location on Marbella's Golden Mile
Sophisticated contemporary design blending Japanese minimalism with Andalusian flair
Exclusive rooftop bar and pool with panoramic Mediterranean views
cons: Limited availability during peak summer season
